checks.title: Two independent node operators agree
checks.plainEnglish: Two separate companies running X Layer nodes report exactly the same block and the same contract data.
checks.detail: OKX and dRPC return the same hash for block 75188092 and identical answers for 13,554 contract reads (10 sections compared by SHA-256).

checks.title: Data is fresh
checks.plainEnglish: The audit read the chain as it was moments ago, not an old copy.
checks.detail: Pinned block 75188092 is 16 s old at read time (limit 300 s, the TapeKit maxBlockAgeSeconds rule).

checks.title: Processor factory code is the audited version
checks.plainEnglish: The contract that creates processors still runs the exact code that was reviewed.
checks.detail: Factory 0x1f09daefa827f02cbb40967cc91b259763760761 runs implementation 0xb41c1e7602eb5734be2430b72178ccb814a5293d, which is on the audited list.

checks.title: Circuit (processor NFT) code is the audited version
checks.plainEnglish: Every processor NFT contract borrows its code from one place, and that place still points at the reviewed code.

checks.title: Website store (SiteRegistry) code is the audited version
checks.plainEnglish: The contract that stores every on-chain website file still runs the reviewed code.
checks.detail: SiteRegistry 0xd6efb7adcc9c83dc4924ad56f6a8e4e969b9adb6 runs implementation 0xa85c4143d1d4a77f54b8e4ecc9e6d1418afea45f, which is on the audited list.

checks.title: Payment contract (DomainBinding) code is the audited version
checks.plainEnglish: The contract that records paid names and domains still runs the reviewed code.
checks.detail: DomainBinding 0x68809fd2fb343aa57d0aeb7f33defe477c9666f9 runs implementation 0x5ebf29b80789e548907c707530c3c7607c4347df, which is on the audited list.

checks.title: Owners and admin keys unchanged
checks.plainEnglish: Nobody has quietly handed control of the core contracts to a new address.
checks.detail: 17 control values match the baseline recorded at block 73368583 except circuitBeacon.owner, transistorBeacon.owner renounced to 0x0 (processors frozen; control removed, not handed over); contracts are wired to each other as documented (registry->opener, binding->registry, factory->beacons). ERC-1967 admin slots are empty (UUPS: upgrades are owner-gated in code).

checks.title: Transistor code unchanged
checks.plainEnglish: The code behind transistors (the building blocks of circuits) is the same as when monitoring started.
checks.detail: Transistor beacon 0x1059ad62cabb6a6925bb65aa617300556c60a51b -> implementation 0x265bf10fab9ddec0ee0a649c6b9db845f1b9a06b (baseline-pinned; TapeKit publishes no expected value for it).

checks.title: Processor factory is sealed
checks.plainEnglish: Once sealed, nobody can change how processors work; until then the owner still can.
checks.detail: Processors are FROZEN: both beacons have no owner, so nobody can change the code of the 414 existing processors. factory.isSealed() = False: the factory itself is still upgradeable by 0xb3d85b42a045c1a88d800cad0f55d2566a4d3138 (affects new processors only).

checks.title: Every processor is genuine
checks.plainEnglish: Each of the numbered processors is a real, unique contract created by the official factory and running the official circuit code.
checks.detail: All 414 processors (0..413): unique addresses, isCPU() = true, deployed code present (2 distinct bytecode hash(es)), ERC-1967 beacon slot = circuit beacon.

checks.title: Numbering is append-only
checks.plainEnglish: Processor numbers and circuit numbers only ever grow; nothing was renumbered or erased since the last run.
checks.detail: Previous run (block 75159792): 411 processors / 11,611 circuit ids; now 414 / 11,626. All earlier processor addresses are unchanged and no processor's nextId went down.

checks.title: Every opened container belongs to the right circuit
checks.plainEnglish: Each website container really is the wallet of the circuit whose name points to it, so names can't be hijacked.
checks.detail: All 124 opened containers (found by checking isOpened on every one of 11,626 circuit ids): token() returns (196, processor, #ID) and accountOf(processor, #ID) gives back the same address; SiteRegistry.isOpenedContainer() is true for all and false for a non-container control.

checks.title: Website files match their on-chain fingerprints
checks.plainEnglish: Every byte of every on-chain website we re-read hashes to exactly the fingerprint its owner published, so nobody can swap content unnoticed.
checks.detail: Re-read 288 files / 15,999,991 bytes this run (rotating budget 16,000,000 bytes/run): 286 match their declared SHA-256 and size. Coverage: 1582/1585 files (125,550,096/125,766,096 bytes) currently verified against their latest version. fileInfo for all files is identical on OKX and dRPC. 3 file(s) are UNFINISHED UPLOADS: the owner declared the SHA-256 of a larger file but only 24000, 96000, 96000 bytes (whole 24,000-byte chunks) were ever stored, so TapeKit readers will refuse them: 1.2.231.tape/programs/program-eb68f0502c83434d/vendor/three/build/three.core.js; 10.2.4.tape/releases/r-bb49d8168acb-23e0bf10/vendor/docsify.min.js; 4889.2.323.tape/assets/img-02.webp.

checks.title: Paid-name records are consistent
checks.plainEnglish: Each container's 'paid until' date and its live/not-live status tell the same story.
checks.detail: Of 124 opened containers: 59 live (activated), 8 expired, 57 never paid. isContainerLive() agrees with containerPaidUntil() > block time for all. Current monthlyFee = 0 wei (0 OKB) on X Layer.

checks.title: No surprise upgrades or ownership changes
checks.plainEnglish: Nobody has swapped the code or the owner of a core contract, even briefly.

checks.title: Event history matches current state
checks.plainEnglish: Every 'container opened' and 'file written' event we found points at a real, correctly-derived container.
checks.detail: 46 Opened events and FileSet events for 41 containers found in the scanned history; every one maps to a container the live enumeration also finds, with the same processor and #ID.
